work.scenario: Your team is launching a new internal software and needs to ensure everyone is updated and knows how to report issues. The company is also discussing its next steps in digitalizing operations.
key_phrases: Jika ada 'masalah rangkaian', terus hubungi IT.

life.scenario: You're helping a friend with their phone, which isn't connecting to the internet properly. You also discuss the importance of keeping personal data safe on various online services.
key_phrases: Penting untuk 'jaga privasi' bila guna 'platform online'.

tech.scenario: As a tech support specialist, you're guiding a user through 'troubleshooting' their slow 'internet connection'. Your company is also implementing new 'data security' protocols as part of its 'digital transformation' strategy.
key_phrases: Aspek 'keselamatan data' adalah keutamaan dalam 'transformasi digital' kami.
Sila 'mengemaskini' firmware router anda kepada 'versi terkini'.
